title: Apocalypter
description:
Try to survive in this savage post-apocalyptic world with your customized cars. You must fight, help or trade to stay alive. Eliminate all the warlords and attach their trophies to your car. Find different cars and customize them with Apocalypter's unique customization system. Scavenge, loot and build your perfect car to survive the procedurally generated, open world of Apocalypter.

Car customization

Any kind of car part can be installed to any car, no limitations. Install better suspension, engine, radiator. Cosmetic parts such as steering wheel, gear lever, seats etc. Move and rotate engine, exhaust or radiator to you liking with the part adjuster tool. Install roof rack, crates and boxes for more storage.

Combat

Many different melee and ranged weapons, guns with different stats and calibers. Enemies also use these weapons and randomly drop their ammo, weapons or healing items. Equip body armor, bandage or first aid kit.

Survival

Eat the bugs, dogfood and mystery meats. Make you car into a moving base, by using portable maggot farms, dew collectors, weed and tobacco plants. Butcher animals, mutants and cook their meat.

Exploration

Explore the infinite, procedurally generated world. Use your compass and landmarks to navigate. Follow roads for easier navigation, but don't get attached to them, sometimes they lead to nowhere. Find abandoned buildings, wrecks, caves, faction camps and bases. Trade or fight with different factions.

Trade

Sell items that you looted and don't need. Buy various items from traders. Merchants have randomized items that they sell and buy. Currency in Apocalypter is rusted nuts, collect them and use them to buy items you need.

Character upgrade

Upgrade your character with body armor, backpack, flashlight and binocular for better survivability.

Features:

• Post-apocalyptic world

• Customizable cars

• Lot's of car parts that can be installed to any car

• Different melee and ranged weapons

• Factions

• Many different enemy types, mutants

• Boss fights

• Scavenge, loot, survive

• Butchering, cooking

• Character upgrades (body armor, backpack, flashlight etc)

• Trading, buy/sell

• Open world

• Procedurally generated random world

• Day/Night cycle

• Partial Controller Support (driving only) 

• Steering wheel support

Demo note: The Demo is an outdated version of the game with much less content, only one car, one boss, and only one save slot.
description_short: Apocalypter is a post-apocalyptic, driving, survival, fps, open-world game. Fight, help, trade with different factions. Find different cars and customize them. Scavenge, loot and survive the procedurally generated, open world of Apocalypter.
